bagPolicy.summary: One clear bag up to 12" x 12" x 12" per ticket holder, or a small clutch or fanny pack up to 5.5" x 7.5", is allowed.
allowed: One clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12" x 12" x 12"
Small clutch or fanny pack up to 5.5" x 7.5"
bagPolicy.note: Air Force Athletics says the clear bag policy applies to events at Falcon Stadium. Diaper bags with an infant present and breast pumping equipment are allowed after search. Medical exemptions can be requested at least three business days ahead.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Falcon Stadium can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Rideshare vehicles must enter through the North Gate. Use Lot 6 for pickup and drop-off, with stadium access through Gates 8 and 10. Return rides may involve waits longer than 90 minutes.

concessions.note: The document provides a sample menu for the Air Force Academy Athletics, detailing various food and drink options available at Falcon Stadium. It includes a range of catering services, but specific highlights or special offerings are not detailed in the provided content.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Buy accessible seats at AFtickets.com or by calling the Ticket Office at 719-472-1895.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: For Air Force Academy athletics events, re-entry is not permitted at Falcon Stadium. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets are on your phone through the Air Force Falcons app or AFtickets.com and can't be accessed on a desktop computer. For non-football events, will call is at the main box office, and you need a valid photo ID to pick up tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For football games, stadium entry gates open 2 hours before kickoff. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
